## Purpose

The single screen where the user dictates, reads and revises a piece. Simple, calm, and readable for long-form text.

## Requirements

1. Two columns: the document on the left (wide), tools and suggestions on the right (narrow).
2. A cursive "C" logo in the top left corner.
3. A compact toolbar in the top right corner: dictate, proofread, versions, publish.
4. Paper texture background; document text set in a serif face at a comfortable reading size and measure.
5. Selecting text shows the selection actions (Rephrase, Substitute) and fills the right column with options (see the selection actions spec).
6. Suggestions in the document are marked inline (underline per kind: grammar, wording, alternative) and link to their card on the right.
7. Light theme in v1; the layout holds from 1100px to full screen width.
8. Designs: three variants drawn on this spec (A follows the brief above; B and C ignore the brief's layout and look to explore other directions). The accepted variant becomes the build target.

## Out of scope

- Dark theme.
- Custom fonts per document.

## Acceptance checks

- The accepted design variant matches the built screen side by side.
- Text stays readable (contrast >= 4.5:1) on the paper texture.
- Window at 1100px wide shows both columns with no horizontal scroll.

## Purpose

The single screen where the user dictates, reads and revises a piece. Simple, calm, and readable for long-form text. Build target: design variant B (manuscript with margin notes), with the review pins applied.

## Requirements

1. White paper background with a visible paper texture.
2. Top bar: the cursive C logo (the supplied SVG) on the left, the document breadcrumb (Library / title / kind) in the centre, and on the right the auto-fixed count, the pending suggestions counter and the version stepper.
3. One centered serif column for the document (about 680px measure).
4. Suggestions sit in the margins next to the lines they touch: wording and grammar notes on the left, each with Apply and Ignore.
5. Selecting or clicking highlighted text opens the Rephrase / Substitute / Sentence card on the right, and the span under review gets an animated (marching) outline until the card closes.
6. Publish is hidden while any suggestion is pending; it appears in the top bar once every suggestion is applied or ignored.
7. A floating dictation bar at the bottom: idle it is a plain red circle; pressed, it turns into a stop button with a spinning ring, a live waveform and the elapsed time. Proofread all sits in the same bar.
8. Light theme in v1; the layout holds from 1100px to full screen width.

## Out of scope

- Dark theme.
- Custom fonts per document.

## Acceptance checks

- Built screen matches the accepted design side by side.
- Text stays readable (contrast >= 4.5:1) on the texture.
- Publish is absent with 1 pending suggestion and present with 0.
- Record button: idle shows a red circle, recording shows stop + spinning ring.
